paragraphs: Zach Daudet was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Thursday, batted ninth and started at third base for Corpus Christi Hooks against Midland RockHounds. Corpus Christi Hooks fell to Midland RockHounds, 3-5.
Zach Daudet went 1-for-2, 1 run scored, 1 walk, 1 stolen base.
title: Zach Daudet represents Cal Poly in Thursday's pro action
